headline: Kai, Trump gave the UN two endings for Iran — a deal or annihilation — and crude, down six straight sessions, is pricing the first one.
subline: Oil keeps shedding its war premium, the Nasdaq set another record on the AI tape, and September's flash PMIs land mid-morning.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · equity figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Crude's slide reaches a sixth session
items.sentence: WTI slipped to about $90.07 and Brent held near $99.54 as Trading Economics counts a sixth straight daily decline, tied to US–Iran diplomacy and a restored Saudi pipeline.

items.title: Nasdaq notches another record close
items.sentence: Trading Economics logs Tuesday's Nasdaq at a record 27,244 with the S&P 500 flat and the Dow down 185 points, and its futures board tilts the same way this morning.

items.title: The 10-year sits just under five percent
items.sentence: Trading Economics marks the 10-year essentially unchanged at 4.96%, still parked just below the five percent line.

items.title: Gold keeps sliding from January's record
items.sentence: Spot gold is off 1.11% at $4,315.98, per Trading Economics, now well beneath the $5,608.35 record set in January.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $86,000 into the open
items.sentence: Coinbase quotes bitcoin at $86,798 this morning, up 1.38% over the past 24 hours from $85,600.

items.title: Trump to UN: an Iran deal, or annihilation
items.sentence: At the General Assembly he framed his choice as make a deal with Iran "or do I annihilate the Islamic Republic," predicting a deal after the midterms, per Axios.

items.title: Zelenskyy floats energy ceasefire and trilateral meeting
items.sentence: CNBC reports Zelenskyy says Ukraine is ready for an "energy ceasefire" and is calling for a three-way meeting with Putin and Trump.

items.title: Tehran warns it can widen the war
items.sentence: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said US escalation would "change the geography of the war," AP reports via Just Security's roundup.

items.title: Houthis push for high ground in Yemen
items.sentence: Reuters, via the same roundup, reports Iran-aligned Houthi forces advanced on strategic heights while Trump reportedly declined to pledge support to Riyadh.

items.title: Meta's Muse tops the App Store
items.sentence: Muse hit 2.8 million downloads in 12 days — a faster start than ChatGPT, per Evercore ISI in Yahoo Finance's live blog — and Monday's 11.3% Meta rally added $192 billion in value.

items.title: The frontier model price war is on
items.sentence: AI Weekly's roundup has OpenAI's new GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half prior pricing, Anthropic's Opus 5.5 at 40% lower cost, and xAI's Grok 4.7 undercutting both.

items.title: Newsom signs seven data-center bills
items.sentence: California's new laws cover data-center electricity costs, water use and local oversight, per Crypto Integrated's September 22 roundup.

items.title: X opens stock and crypto trading
items.sentence: Musk's X added trading through Coinbase, Kraken and Interactive Brokers, per CoinDesk, which also counts nearly $1 billion of Monday inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs, the ninth-largest day on record.

items.title: Nvidia adapts to a power-constrained buildout
items.sentence: Crypto Integrated reports Nvidia is steering toward smaller data centers, GPU-efficiency software and electricity partnerships as grid constraints bite.
